verdict.rationale: The firm's formation page says it helps founders make tax-efficient choices about structuring their ownership, and its executive compensation page mentions designing restricted stock with vesting schedules. That vesting reference concerns employee and employer incentives, not founder-specific mechanics. Neither page explains 83(b) elections or how to split equity among co-founders; they describe services rather than offering founder guidance. Missing for 10: any mention of 83(b) elections or a local equivalent, guidance on co-founder equity splits, founder-specific vesting material, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's own materials cover founder equity mechanics — vesting schedules, 83(b) elections or the local equivalent, and equity splits among co-founders — so day-zero ownership is set up right

citations.quote: we help founders make optimal, tax-efficient choices around how to structure their business entities and ownership
We design equity instruments (restricted stock, incentive and non-statutory stock options, RSUs, SARs, phantom stock and more) with design features, vesting schedules, acceleration triggers
